theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (D : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → MeasurableSet D → (∀ w ∈ D, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ ball w ε → ν W ≤ μ W) → ν D ≤ μ D
